description: Ask FFraud for an API key for the person you work for. FFraud emails them one Approve button, and nothing is created until they press it. Returns signup_id and claim_token: tell the person to open the email from FFraud and press Approve, then call claim_api_key with both. Use it only when the person wants a key and gave you their own email address.

agent.description: Your name as the person knows you, e.g. "Claude Code". The email shows it.

email.description: The person's own email address; the approval email goes there.

name: request_api_key
title: Get an FFraud API key
